card.line: Perez-uzza is the place where Uzzah died after touching the ark of God, and David gave it a name that means the breaking out against Uzzah.

moments.title: Uzzah dies at the ark
moments.text: The anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah because he had put his hand on the ark. He struck Uzzah down, and Uzzah died there before God.

moments.title: David names the place
moments.text: David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.

moments.title: David fears God and moves the ark
moments.text: David feared God and asked how he could ever bring the ark to himself. He took it aside to the house of Obed-edom, and the LORD blessed that household for three months.
